title: Verify: Admin round routes reject missing and wrong tokens unit tests
summary: Server-level tests for round routes with missing and wrong tokens.
description: Extend server_test.go with wrong-token coverage for the round routes using httptest and a temp dir.
acceptance_criteria: Round routes return 401 without a token.

steps.action: Build the server as in TestNew_AdminRoundsRequireToken (token 'tok', t.TempDir repo). Iterate adminRoundRoutes(&admin.RoundHandler{}) replacing {id} with ROUND-0000001; for each, request with no Authorization header and with 'Bearer wrong'; assert rec.Code == 401. Import the admin package.
steps.expected: Test passes with 5 routes x 2 cases all 401.

steps.action: Assert adminRoundRoutes returns exactly the five method+pattern pairs: POST /rounds, POST /rounds/{id}/open, POST /rounds/{id}/close, GET /rounds/{id}, GET /rounds/{id}/contributions.
